verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same, and both share the same flaws. The pink circle is no longer behind the bottle; it sits alone, cropped, in the bottom-right corner. The quote mark floats about 60px above its headline. The headline is set small on one line and loses out to the large bottle. The left-aligned text block clashes with the centred bottle and button. A is pushed up: the top feels cramped, and there is a dead gap of about 145px between the button and the logo. B moves the whole stack down, which balances the space top to bottom better, so it is slightly less lopsided.
